accounting_rules.decimal_arithmetic: Python Decimal with no intermediate rounding
accounting_rules.q1: one same-span source fact has both reported-quarter and same-span-YTD roles
accounting_rules.q2_q3: same-fiscal-year current-YTD minus prior-YTD, cross-checked against a reported quarter when present
accounting_rules.q4: reported fiscal-year value minus the same-fiscal-year nine-month value
accounting_rules.ttm: four consecutive quarter cells are summed in the separate TTM golden
accounting_rules.cash: opening and closing values are instant facts at start-minus-one-day and period end
accounting_rules.point_in_time: select the latest eligible fact accepted on or before the cohort cutoff; retain rejected and superseded candidate IDs in cell decisions
accounting_rules.revision_scope: the retained cohort originals contain the required quarter/year filings only; this independent reference does not claim complete amendment-lineage discovery
